title: Use durable bounded workers and recover jobs after restart
description:
Context: mandatory README/canonical-plan promise, audited 2026-10-13 at e6c884429dc841cfa897c63186f0009d46792802.

Current evidence: /jobs launches asyncio tasks in the API process and JobManager snapshots/events are memory-only. Fresh process can fetch persisted Markdown but GET /jobs/<completed-id> returns 500. Arq queue infrastructure is unwired; worker processes nonexistent _process_job, and run_worker is sync but awaited inside asyncio.run.

Implementation and scope: Revise app/jobs.py/app/queue.py/scripts/run_worker.py to submit through durable bounded queue with job UUID identity, idempotent ownership, durable state/events, priority queues, cancellation and crash recovery. Worker calls public real execute_capture_job pipeline and records terminal outcomes. Use correct Arq enqueue/worker APIs and Redis sorted-set queue cardinality; consume all advertised priorities. Hydrate completed snapshots from Store for fresh processes.

Acceptance and proof: Separate API and real Redis/worker processes complete captures; restart API/worker during capture does not lose job, duplicate side effects or terminal event; all priority jobs drain; configured global browser/OCR caps hold under 50 submissions. Completed status/events/artifacts work from another process. No multiple-worker recommendation until this proof passes.

Ship targeted unit and integration tests with the fix, including happy path, boundary/empty inputs and refusal conditions. Companion public E2E proof must use real services where the goal requires them. Log command, commit SHA, input fixture digest, backend/build/transport/style/model/retry metadata, request IDs and expected/observed results without secrets. No gate weakening, automatic golden regeneration, deletion or proof-class inflation. This issue stays open until its criteria have cited evidence.

title: Profile_id passthrough & persistent contexts
description:
PLAN §4.1 (POST /jobs), §5 (profile chooser), and §7 (persistent browser profiles + manifest flags) require that `profile_id` travel from the UI/CLI into capture so authenticated sessions live under isolated Chromium directories. Today the API schemas accept `profile_id`, the UI and CLI send it, but `JobManager`/`capture_tiles` ignore it, so every job still runs in a transient profile.

Tasks:
- Thread `profile_id` through `JobCreateRequest`, `JobManager`, and `capture` so each job can reuse `~/.mdwb/profiles/<id>` directories, including manifest + RunRecord metadata (`manifest.profile_id`).
- Enforce safe directory names, create the profile directory on demand, and add retention policies + tests.
- Update docs/PLAN/README to describe how operators configure profiles, the new manifest field, and the security guidance for red/blue separation.
- Add regression tests (API + capture) proving that profile ids persist and manifest output changes when using different ids.
